open_task_policy: Accept every independently verified solution under the actual hypotheses. Valid shorter or alternative routes receive full credit. Explicit added-assumption results are separate contributions; they do not complete the original task unless the added assumptions are proved from the given data. Honest incompleteness is distinct from invalid proof.
required_evidence: Construct the observation norm on the actual algebraic quotient E/ker(A), and its completion with the canonical isometric linear realization into H; identify the image as closure(range A) and justify uniqueness.
Construct the unique minimizer in the completion, prove the recovery map is linear and 1-Lipschitz, and establish equality with the original-space infimum.
Give a necessary and sufficient original attainment criterion and describe every original minimizer as the appropriate kernel coset.
critical_errors: Apply a Hilbert projection theorem directly to range(A) without establishing that it is closed/complete.
Assume E is a Hilbert space or introduce an adjoint A* on E without supplying legitimate structure and existence.
Substitute a norm inherited from an unspecified norm on E for the explicitly prescribed observation norm.
Infer existence of an original vector from existence of a completion point or from equality of infima.
Infer uniqueness of original minimizers from uniqueness of the observation/completion minimizer.
Assume A injective, surjective, finite rank, or closed range and report that restricted result as solving the original problem.
completion_policy: All stated construction, uniqueness, linear stability and original-solution classification goals are required. Boundary examples and the author route are evaluator evidence, not mandatory candidate output. A correct use of completion plus the Hilbert projection theorem is allowed; no minimum proof length is imposed.
